summary: DCP with 3 or 6 ranks compiles; padded recurrent state rows use the null block
details: The DCP attention-output correction required a power-of-two rank count, so DCP 3 or 6 failed to compile.
CUDA-graph padding rows of aligned recurrent state indices pointed at -1 instead of the reserved null block; consumers that skip the null block could address memory before the state pool.
Both were found by BoxTops4Coochie's GLM-5.3-Flash TP3 port.
